description.subject: A crocheted toy doll made of cream and red cotton thread stitched over stuffing, with black glass eyes and a smile embroidered in dark thread.
description.covering: It wears a red crocheted dress with long sleeves, a ruffled skirt hem and an attached cowl that sits over the back and sides of the skull, two orange faceted gem buttons at the chest, cream crocheted mitten-like cuffs, cream legs, and dark tan knitted boots that reach the ankle.
description.posture: It stands on its two feet with its arms hanging slightly out from the sides, facing the camera directly.
description.setting: It stands on a bed of polished pebbles outdoors, in front of a dark metal slatted bench with green showing between the slats.
description.light: Soft, even daylight from the front and slightly overhead, neutral to slightly warm in colour, with no sharp shadows.
description.materials: Crocheted cotton thread, orange faceted acrylic gems, glossy black eye fittings, tumbled stone pebbles in tan, grey and white, and painted slatted metal.
